title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: employer administrative services and invoicing terms by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's employer-facing administrative services: HR portal access for roster management, aggregate usage reporting and its frequency, whether a dedicated account manager is assigned, and how and on what terms the employer's master invoice is delivered.

| Tier | HR portal access | Usage reporting provided | Usage reporting frequency | Dedicated account manager | Invoice delivery method | Invoice payment terms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | No | No | Not provided | No | Email | Net 15 days |
| Small Business Partner | Yes | Yes | Every 90 days | No | Email | Net 30 days |
| Mid-Market Partner | Yes | Yes | Every 30 days | Yes | Portal | Net 30 days |
| Enterprise Partner | Yes | Yes | Every 30 days | Yes | Portal | Net 45 days |
| Municipal Partner | Yes | Yes | Every 90 days | Yes | Mail | Net 45 days |
| Nonprofit Partner | Yes | Yes | Every 90 days | No | Email | Net 30 days |

Where usage reporting is not provided for a tier, no reporting frequency applies.
